#include <assert.h>

#include <stdio.h>

#include "ts_pack.h"

    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"sparql\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process("SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s ?p ?o }", config_handle);
